Alper Ferudun, A Negative Answer to Wolansky's Question on Mutually Dominating Multiphase Measure Spaces, v1.0 (2026-10-02), Theorem3.1(1), pp.4-5. Existing full negative answer: compact standard Borel interval/square, two atomless probability components, one common probability kernel each way; reverse projection exists but no forward deterministic componentwise map. PR1276's densities(1,2x)/(1,2u) are an invertible repackaging of the prior(x,1-x)/(u,1-u) pair. Nonexistence persists for completed-source-measurable maps into the Borel target; no simultaneous extension of the forward kernel to every completed planar target set asserted. Unrefereed AI-assisted preprint; this audit verifies only the cited construction, without endorsing other paper claims or historical firstness.
